symbols.name: vector length
symbols.meaning: The number of entries of u, which is the length of every vector in the transform.
symbols.quote: Let $u=(u_0,\dots,u_{q-1})$ be a complex vector of length $q$, where $q$ is the number of entries of $u$.

symbols.name: input vector
symbols.meaning: The complex vector of length q that the transform acts on; here u is not the first input of earlier pages.
symbols.quote: Let $u=(u_0,\dots,u_{q-1})$ be a complex vector of length $q$, where $q$ is the number of entries of $u$.

symbols.name: root of unity
symbols.meaning: The primitive q-th root of unity exp(-2 pi i/q) used by the transform.
symbols.quote: Let $\omega=\exp(-2\pi i/q)$ be a [primitive $q$-th root of unity](roots-of-unity.md), so $\omega^q=1$ and no smaller positive power of $\omega$ equals $1$.

symbols.name: transform
symbols.meaning: The discrete Fourier transform of u, a vector of length q with entries indexed by k.
symbols.quote: The transform of $u$, written $\hat u$, has entries $\hat u_k$, where $j$ indexes the entries of $u$ and $k$ indexes those of $\hat u$, each from $0$ to $q-1$, given by

symbols.name: input index
symbols.meaning: The position of an entry of u, running from 0 to q-1 in the transform sum.
symbols.quote: The transform of $u$, written $\hat u$, has entries $\hat u_k$, where $j$ indexes the entries of $u$ and $k$ indexes those of $\hat u$, each from $0$ to $q-1$, given by

symbols.name: output index
symbols.meaning: The position of an entry of the transform, running from 0 to q-1.
symbols.quote: The transform of $u$, written $\hat u$, has entries $\hat u_k$, where $j$ indexes the entries of $u$ and $k$ indexes those of $\hat u$, each from $0$ to $q-1$, given by

symbols.name: second summation index
symbols.meaning: The position of an entry of b, running from 0 to q-1 in the convolution sum.
symbols.quote: Let $c$ be their cyclic convolution, $c_l=\sum_{j+t\equiv l\ (\mathrm{mod}\ q)}a_j b_t$, where $t$ indexes the entries of $b$ and $l$ indexes the entries of $c$.

symbols.name: output position
symbols.meaning: The position of an entry of the cyclic convolution c, running from 0 to q-1.
symbols.quote: Let $c$ be their cyclic convolution, $c_l=\sum_{j+t\equiv l\ (\mathrm{mod}\ q)}a_j b_t$, where $t$ indexes the entries of $b$ and $l$ indexes the entries of $c$.

symbols.name: operation count
symbols.meaning: The number of operations the FFT uses on a vector of length q.
symbols.quote: Let $N(q)$ count the operations on length $q$; splitting gives $N(q)=2N(q/2)+O(q)$, which solves to $O(q\log q)$.

relations.quote: It matters because it turns [cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md) into entrywise products.
